title: GameSystem release, schema version 2
description: The Published Language between Studio and Play: the content of one immutable GameSystem release with trackers, fact slots, Scene Types and NarrativeFlows (ADR 0017, ADR 0018). This schema encodes the structural rules only. Semantic rules are enforced by the Studio domain and are not expressible here: every rule of schema version 1, unique keys (trackers, fact slots, tags, Scene Types, flows, phases, steps, choice options, table entries, table branches), unique and existing tags in picks, counts and effects, pick counts with min at most max, forward-only "next", band ordering, references to trackers, Scene Types, oracles, levels and entries, the trackers and oracles each flow may use, at most one default flow, counter and chaos tracker ranges, suggested choices naming "skip", oracle-selection tables, dice notation, placeholders, trimmed lengths, and the gear catalog, the currency, inventory categories and shop offers (ADR 0045). Optional fields may be omitted or null. See docs/contracts/gamesystem-release.md.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this contract. Not the release version, which Studio assigns when publishing.

theme.description: The curated Theme Play applies inside a Campaign pinned to this release. Optional; omitted or null means the default app theme.

trackers.description: Counters and clocks a Campaign holds a value for. May be empty.

factSlots.description: Slots a Campaign fills with facts: a text, an NPC, a Thread or a Place. Flows fill them with the fillFact effect. May be empty.

tags.description: Tags NPCs, Threads and Places carry, picked and counted by key. Optional; may be empty.

sceneTypes.description: Release-level Scene Types the flows select. May be empty.

flows.description: NarrativeFlows. May be empty: the GameSystem is then played freely.

sheet.description: The character sheet template (ADR 0022). {} and {"fields": []} are the same sheet: no fields. Field keys are unique (checked by the domain). The layout (ADR 0031) is groups in a grid: columns, groups and field spans need declared groups, every field then names a declared group, and a group span is at most the sheet columns and a field span at most its group columns (checked by the domain).

currency.description: The sheet's currency (ADR 0045): a number field (checked by the domain) and the unit shown after amounts.

pointBudgets.description: Several point budgets (ADR 0043), instead of pointBudget: declaring both is refused, and a field is in at most one budget (checked by the domain). A list of one budget is the same as pointBudget.

checks.description: The checks of the release (ADR 0024): at most 50, keys unique (checked by the domain).

gear.description: The gear catalog (ADR 0045): what shops sell and inventories hold. Optional; may be empty. Keys unique, names unique trimmed and ignoring case (checked by the domain).

key.description: Lowercase identifier: a-z, 0-9 and "-", 1 to 64 characters.

sheetField.description: One field of the sheet, by its type.

gearEntry.description: One entry of the gear catalog (ADR 0045). slots is per unit, 1 by default.

gearCategory.description: A category label of the gear catalog, matched exactly.

gearCategories.description: Distinct category labels, each the category of a catalog entry (checked by the domain).

inventoryField.description: Stacks of gear (ADR 0045): catalog entries it accepts with a quantity, or free stacks. Without categories it accepts every entry.

numberField.description: A bounded integer. min <= default <= max (checked by the domain).

roll.description: A dice default (ADR 0040): rolled by the server when a Character is created. The static default stays the value wherever nothing is rolled. The dice are checked by the domain.

pointBudget.description: The points a Character spends across number fields when it is created (ADR 0040). min and max bound those fields at creation only. min <= max, every field keeps a value inside both its own and these bounds, and the lowest values fit in total (checked by the domain).

fields.description: Keys of number fields of the sheet, each once (checked by the domain).

keyedPointBudget.description: A point budget of a list (ADR 0043): a pointBudget with a key, unique in the list (checked by the domain), and a required label.

fields.description: Keys of number fields of the sheet, each once (checked by the domain).

sheetGroup.description: A group of the sheet layout (ADR 0031). Names are unique, compared exactly (checked by the domain).

textField.description: Free text, 200 characters by default and 2000 when multiline.

listField.description: A list of short texts, such as an inventory.

trackField.description: A resource track {current, max}, such as hit points. A fixed max when set, else each Character sets its own.

startMax.description: A formula for the max a Character's track starts with (ADR 0040), not with max. It reads number fields and derived fields that depend on no track and no tracker (checked by the domain).

derivedField.description: A DerivedValue: computed from other fields and trackers by a formula (ADR 0023), never stored. References, kinds, cycles and syntax are checked by the domain.

conditionsField.description: A set of conditions a Character marks and clears (ADR 0041). Its value is the marked option keys; a formula reads the count marked. Option keys are unique in the field (checked by the domain).

formulaText.description: A formula such as "({dex}-10)/2" or "{tracker:chaos}*2" (ADR 0023); its syntax is checked by the domain.

formulaRef.description: A formula. Its scope depends on where it sits: a flow formula reads trackers only, a sheet effect value reads the sheet.

diceRef.description: A dice expression of the Randomness kernel, rolled when the effect is applied.

appliesTo.description: The entity kinds the tag may be carried by, unique; absent or null, it applies to all of them.

tagKeys.description: Tag keys of the release, unique; at most 5.

trackerRef.description: The current value of a tracker.

credits.description: The notice, license and link a release carries, such as a fan preset's publisher disclaimer (ADR 0021). Optional; omitted or null means no credits.

notice.description: The text Play shows. Trimmed, 1 to 2000 characters.

license.description: The name of the license or policy the content is provided under.

url.description: Where the license or policy is published: an absolute https:// URL.

badge.description: A publisher logo Play shows beside the notice; the SPA ships the image (ADR 0044). Optional; omitted or null means none.

tables.description: One oracle table set (Randomness OracleTableSet). May be empty.

likelihood.description: Likelihood oracles (Randomness LikelihoodOracle). May be empty.

oracleTable.description: A ranged table has "dice" and entries with "min" and "max"; a weighted table has no "dice" and entries with an optional "weight".

dice.description: Dice notation, e.g. 1d6; ranged tables only.

oracleTableEntry.description: An entry needs a non-empty "text" unless it nests a "table".

table.description: Key of a table of the same set to roll on next.

key.description: Names the entry for table-step branches; unique within its table.

sceneType.description: A Scene Type this entry offers or selects.

effects.description: Applied when a flow step rolls the entry.

randomEvent.description: A d100 roll that is a double (11, 22 ... 99) whose digit is at most the chaos factor used triggers a random event on the table. Needs chaos and sides 100; the table is one of oracles.tables.

table.description: Key of an oracle table of the release.

target.description: Highest roll that answers yes at the neutral chaos factor; 0..sides.

tracker.description: A counter tracker whose min and max equal this chaos min and max; its value is the chaos factor.

levels.description: Named ranges of the value, ordered like outcome bands with literal upTo only.

segments.description: A clock starts at 0 and fills up to segments.

oracles.description: Oracle shortcuts of this Scene Type: keys of oracle tables or likelihood oracles.
Oracles the flow shows; every reachable Scene Type's oracles are among them.

trackers.description: Trackers the flow shows and uses; every tracker reference the flow reaches is among them.

description.description: What the phase is for and when it is done; Play shows it under the phase and when the player ends it.

sceneTypes.description: Played in order; a type may repeat.

table.description: An oracle table whose every entry names a sceneType.

optionalSteps.description: A hook step list; empty by default.

next.description: A later step key of the same list, or "end" to end the part.

shopStep.description: Sells gear of its offer for the sheet currency and buys at sellRate percent of the cost (ADR 0045). Never skipped, so never mandatory; its effects hold no sheet effect, and the domain checks the references: offered keys and categories exist, each offered entry lands in an inventory field, the sheet has a currency, an integer stock is at most the offer's size.

offer.description: Catalog keys and categories, at least one entry in all.

stock.description: How many distinct entries of the offer are on sale: an integer, or dice rolled when the step is reached. Absent: the whole offer.

check.description: A named rule: dice or a pool, an optional formula modifier over sheet values (never with a pool), an optional difficulty, an optional push for a pool and outcome bands (ADR 0024, 0041). Dice notation, formulas, band keys and order, the difficulty range and successAt <= sides are checked by the domain.

dice.description: Dice notation, e.g. 1d10. Exactly one of dice or pool.

modifier.description: A formula over sheet values, added to the dice total. A pool check refuses it (checked by the domain).

push.description: Only with a pool (checked by the domain).

checkPool.description: A pool of dice that each succeed at or above successAt (ADR 0041); the check total is the number of successes, plus the bonus of critical pairs. Some of its dice may be Hunger dice (ADR 0044). successAt <= sides is checked by the domain; count formulas read the sheet like a modifier.

criticals.description: Every pair of dice showing the top face (sides), in any group, adds bonus successes (ADR 0044).

hunger.description: How many dice of the pool are Hunger dice, clamped to the pool size: never pushed, rolled in a second colour (ADR 0044). A count formula reads the sheet like pool.count.

checkPush.description: A pool check may be pushed once: its failed regular dice re-roll, at most maxDice of them, and the cost effects apply (ADR 0041, 0044). Hunger dice never re-roll. Effects are sheet and tracker effects only, checked by the domain.

maxDice.description: Re-roll only the first maxDice failed regular dice, in roll order. Omitted or null: every failed regular die.

checkDifficulty.description: The target the player sets at roll time; band formulas read it as {check:difficulty}. min <= default <= max (checked by the domain).

checkBand.description: An outcome band of a check: ordered upper bounds; only the last omits upTo and catches the rest.

checkStep.description: Rolls a check for a Character and branches on the outcome band; a band without an entry in outcomes continues. Names exactly one check, or a set of 2 to 10 checks with the same band keys the player picks from (ADR 0042); the domain checks the keys and the shared bands.

check.description: Key of a check of the release. Exactly one of check or checks.

checks.description: Keys of 2 to 10 unique checks of the release with the same band keys. Exactly one of check or checks.

difficulty.description: Fixes the difficulty; only for a check (every check of a set) that declares one.

outcomes.description: Each entry names a band or a special result (ADR 0044), each at most once; a special entry wins over the band's. The domain checks that the band exists and that the check can produce the special result.

band.description: Key of a band of the check.

special.description: A special result of a pool roll.

characterStep.description: Completes with the Character the player picks, or creates from the step.

inspiration.description: Oracle tables (keys) the player may roll for ideas while answering. Suggestions only: they have no effects and are not rolled by the step.

oracleStep.description: Asks a likelihood oracle and branches on its answer.

likelihood.description: A level key of that oracle.

branches.description: An exceptional answer without its branch uses yes / no.

tableStep.description: Rolls an oracle table and branches per rolled entry.

table.description: An oracle table key; the table rolled when tableBySceneType does not name the current Scene Type.

tableBySceneType.description: Scene Type key to oracle table key (ADR 0042), 1 entry or more; the domain checks that each key is a Scene Type and each value a table, and that there are no branches with it.

entry.description: An entry key of the step's table, unique in the list.

rollStep.description: Rolls dice and branches on the total.

choiceStep.description: The player picks one option. A suggested choice names the option a skip follows.

skip.description: The option key a skipped choice follows.

conditionStep.description: Compares a tracker, or the number of open NPCs, Threads or Places, to bands; never mandatory, never skipped, writes no entry. Exactly one of tracker or count.

conditionCount.description: The number of open items of a kind carrying all the tags.

pickStep.description: Picks open NPCs, Threads, Places or Characters carrying all the tags: at random, or chosen by the player. Outcome found or none.

count.description: How many to pick; {1, 1} by default. min must not exceed max.

band.description: An outcome band: ordered upper bounds; only the last omits upTo and catches the rest.

label.description: Names the outcome the band stands for.

oneOf.description: Changes a field of a Character: add, subtract or set a number or track field, mark or clear an option of a conditions field (ADR 0041). Allowed only in a check step's outcomes, a character step's effects and a check's push cost; the validator checks the placement, the field type, the option and the formula scope. A mark without a value is allowed only in a push cost.

value.description: An amount for add, subtract and set; an option key for mark and clear.
